name: Brazilian Address Field
description: Brazillian Address Field with postal code consult
project_description:
This defines a new field type to store brazilian postal adresses according to

recommendations of the brazilian postal service company, Correios. The address

consists of the following fields:

 * Thoroughfare (Logradouro): type and name of the thoroughfare

 * Number (Número): the number of thoroughfare

 * Complement (Complemento): apartment number and/or another info

 * Neighborhood (Bairro)

 * City (Cidade)

 * State (Estado)

 * Postal code (CEP)

 Sponsored by 7Links Web Solutions 

 Additional feature 
 It fill automatically the address fields through postal code consuming the webservice viacep.com.br
